features.name: Sign in, sign up, forgot and reset password
features.what: Supabase email/password auth. Sign-up creates an organisation and owner membership.
features.users: Everyone
features.usability_notes: Root `/` still says "Event Content Portal".

features.name: Portal admission gate
features.what: Lets in Stawi admins and anyone with ≥1 organisation membership. Others go to /portal/no-access; /portal/admin/* is Stawi-only.
features.users: Everyone
features.usability_notes: 60s cookie cache. RLS is the real guard.

features.name: Edit own profile
features.what: Edits the signed-in person’s profile fields.
features.users: Every signed-in user

features.name: Organisations admin (products, Planner connection, impact)
features.what: Create organisations. Turn Bendie/Planner products on, pause or resume them per organisation and per event. Connect an organisation to a Planner organisation, with an impact preview.
features.users: Stawi admins

features.name: Content moderation
features.what: Review Report/Block items from the attendee app. Hide/unhide posts and comments, delete messages, remove a person from events (Planner access off too), dismiss, or mark reviewed.
features.users: Stawi admins

features.name: Organisation overview / home
features.what: Product-resolved home: metrics, events overview table, needs-attention, next milestone, quick actions, recent activity.
features.users: All organisation members
features.usability_notes: Uses an 8-check "Setup progress %" that differs from the event Dashboard (see doc 11 and 23).

features.name: Events list and discovery
features.what: Org-wide event list with lifecycle labels and progress, per product.
features.users: All organisation members

features.name: Create event (with products)
features.what: Multi-step dialog: products (Bendie / Planner / both), name, dates, timezone, location, modules. Calls the `create_event_with_products` RPC, then provisions the Planner event when Planner is chosen.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins

features.name: Organisation people
features.what: Directory of organisation members and roles. Add a person, search existing people, CSV import, make/revoke admin. Shows contacts through Bendie RPCs.
features.users: Org members (read); org owners/admins and Stawi admins (write)
features.usability_notes: "Make Admin" grants platform-wide admin (October audit §30.6).

features.name: Teams
features.what: Named groups of organisation people, used as a source in "Add attendees → From team".
features.users: Org members (read), org owners/admins (write)
features.usability_notes: Grants nothing on its own.

features.name: Asset library
features.what: Upload and reuse organisation files and images (org-assets bucket). Picked from content forms via AssetPickerModal.
features.users: All organisation members

features.name: Organisation activity log
features.what: Trigger-written audit trail for organisation-level changes. Also the header bell.
features.users: All organisation members

features.name: Organisation settings
features.what: Read-only organisation fields.
features.users: All organisation members
features.usability_notes: Two read-only fields; reached from both the sidebar and the header.

features.name: Product entitlement and switcher
features.what: Per-organisation products (`organization_products`) and per-event products (`event_products`) decide which areas and tabs exist. A paused product shows a notice.
features.users: Everyone

features.name: Event dashboard and readiness
features.what: Required / Recommended / Optional checklist, "Recommended next", area cards. For Planner events, Planner readiness counts and the next Planner step.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: Required = name+dates and ≥1 member with role exactly `attendee`.

features.name: Manage modules
features.what: Choose which content modules this event uses (`portal_setup_modules`). Decides Recommended vs Optional on the Dashboard.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Basics
features.what: Name, description, dates (venue time), timezone, location, status label, event type, attendee limit.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
consumed_by: Bendie Planner app (timezone once, at creation)
features.usability_notes: `status` is a manual label; there is no publish step.

features.name: Hero & branding
features.what: Hero image, title, description and profile banner for the attendee app home.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Theme colours / Theme designer
features.what: Primary, secondary and tertiary colours with a live app preview (ThemeDesignerModal, EventThemePreview).
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Terminology and menu
features.what: Speaker labels (singular/plural), category and theme labels and icon, feedback form link, disabled menu items.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Speakers (facilitators)
features.what: Speaker and presenter profiles. Can be linked to an account by email (claim). Adding from attendees is supported.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: Live data: 58 of 136 have no bio and 51 no photo.

features.name: Agenda and breakout rooms
features.what: Sessions by day: block type, audience, location, accent colour, speakers (with speaker types). Breakout rooms in three modes, with capacity and assignments (people list download/upload). Org admins may edit.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: 1,267-line page. ~160px cards. Push to Planner is manual.

features.name: Activities
features.what: Experiences with images, rating, location, featured flag. Duplicate is supported.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Excursions (local recommendations)
features.what: Categorised local recommendations. Categories can be global (event_id null).
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: The header action creates a category; an excursion needs a category first.

features.name: Attendees & access
features.what: Event members and roles. Add from org, team, all org people or new (CSV). Access codes are auto-issued and emailed, with resend. Add to speakers. Planner Team & Access row action.
features.users: Event host/organizer/admin, org owners/admins, Stawi admins
features.usability_notes: 521 attendees; 385 members are still `pending` onboarding, a status nothing in the Portal writes.

features.name: Attendee travel
features.what: Per-attendee flight, ground-transfer and other details shown in the app. Pull from Planner (Stawi admins).
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: One attendee at a time; free-text dates and times. Only 4 rows live.

features.name: Networking questionnaire and matchmaking
features.what: Interest questions (single/multi select, short/long text), options, required flags, networking mode (full / attendees-only / off). Flags select questions with no options.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: Organisers type `question_key`/`option_key` by hand.

features.name: Planner team & access (permissions)
features.what: Turn on, change or turn off a person’s Planner access with view/manage flags (Viewer / Manager / Custom). Every change is audited.
features.users: Org owners/admins, Stawi admins
features.usability_notes: Has no screen of its own.

features.name: News feed
features.what: Articles and announcements with themes, image, featured flag, registration link and read time. Can be global.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: FAQs
features.what: Questions grouped by section.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Info center and support contacts
features.what: Info bullets and support contacts. One contact can be shown on the app’s access screen ("Contact organizer").
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Expo directory
features.what: Exhibitors and sponsors: summary, chips, offering, contacts, CTA. Can be global.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Gallery moderation
features.what: Attendee photo posts, likes and comments. Hide or delete through the server route so blocks don’t hide content from moderators.
features.users: Event members (view); Stawi admins or the author (hide/delete)

features.name: Event photos
features.what: Organiser-curated photos (separate from the gallery).
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Files
features.what: Documents for attendees to download, stored in the `event-files` storage bucket.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Emergency contacts and images
features.what: Typed emergency contacts (with location, description, image) and emergency images.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Games / quizzes
features.what: Quiz games with questions. Points and leaderboard are app-side (`game_points`).
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: Answer options are typed as raw JSON.

features.name: Push notifications
features.what: Send now or schedule push messages to event attendees (send-notification-push edge function).
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin
features.usability_notes: High-impact external communication. 10 sent live.

features.name: Event activity log
features.what: Trigger-written audit of content changes (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE with diff).
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Planner event provisioning
features.what: Creates the linked Planner event (name, dates, location, timezone) and tracks status: not_required, pending, provisioning, succeeded or failed. Retry is available.
features.users: Stawi admins, org owners/admins, event host/organizer/admin

features.name: Bendie Planner link and sync
features.what: Link or unlink a Planner event. Staff-tier member sync (automatic). Push agenda to Planner (manual). Pull flights/hotels into attendee travel (manual).
features.users: Stawi admins (usable); listed for everyone
features.usability_notes: Identity is bridged by email, but 353 of 409 Planner passengers have no email.

features.name: Planner overview
features.what: Planner event identity and live session status.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins

features.name: Participants
features.what: People tracked for travel and logistics: add new, from Bendie attendees or from the organisation; link, search, CSV. Grants no access.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins

features.name: Tasks
features.what: Operational to-dos with assignees, status, priority and due date. Batch status changes.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins
features.usability_notes: Task notes are not built (memory.md).

features.name: Vendors
features.what: Supplier equipment items with packed / loaded / on-site stages.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins

features.name: Checklist
features.what: Items to source and check on site, by category and day.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins

features.name: Logistics: flights, hotels, ground transport
features.what: Flights, hotel bookings, movements, vehicles, and passenger-to-vehicle assignment and moves.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins
features.usability_notes: 1,211-line page with a third navigation level (sub-tabs).

features.name: Planner agenda (programme)
features.what: The programme the Planner team sees: days, tracks, rooms, speakers and MCs, parallel items.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins

features.name: Production / run-of-show
features.what: Per-session production rows: times with shift, mode, mic, presentation, main screen, stage-hand notes, guest experience, slides.
features.users: Planner identity with the module view flag (manage flag to edit), org owners/admins, Stawi admins
features.usability_notes: Slides and blueprints authoring are not built (memory.md).

features.name: Chats, messages, connections, session ratings, feedback, game points
features.what: Attendee runtime data. Out of scope by design (project-overview.md); moderation only.
features.users: App users

features.name: App release config (minimum app version)
features.what: Read by the mobile apps. No admin screen (memory.md: Events #5 unbuilt).
features.users: App users

features.name: Automated engagement reminders
features.what: Queued by `enqueue_engagement_notifications`. No labels or controls in the Portal (Events #11 unbuilt).
features.users: App users

features.name: Planner blueprints (venue plans)
features.what: Versioned files per Planner event. No Portal UI.
features.users: App users

features.name: Planner in-app notifications
features.what: Planner-side notification feed and push (push-dispatch edge function).
features.users: App users

features.name: Marketing meeting requests
features.what: Public lead-capture form (submit-meeting-request edge function). Out of scope.
features.users: App users
